Pearl gemstones are referred to as "Queen Gems" and are said to represent purity, innocence, and modesty. Natural Basra Pearl is endowed with inherent healing properties, and it brings balance to the Swadhisthana chakra.

tabs.tab1_description:
Natural Basra Pearl gemstones are formed as a defense mechanism of the Oysters, Clams, and Mussels. When a foreign body or an irritant enters the oyster shell, clam or mussel, the soft tissues or rather the mantle of the living shelled mollusk, it automatically secretes a smooth crystalline substance called 'nacre' to form a coating on the irritant because it is not able to dispel it. This natural process goes on for years to form the natural Pearl stones. It is a misconception that a grain of sand or dirt is the cause of irritation which causes the nacre to be secreted in a mollusk shell. Rather it is considered to be a microorganism or parasite which mostly causes this phenomenon to set in the mantle of the shelled mollusk.

Naturally formed Basra Pearl gemstone is precious, very rare, and highly valuable. It is a combination of calcium carbonate and a complex protein called conchiolin, with a hardness from 2.5 to 4.5 on the Mohs scale. It is interesting to note that the nacre secreted by mollusk shells is called Mother-of-Pearl which is commonly known as Mother Pearl stones. Natural Basra Pearl stones come in a wide variety of natural shapes.

Basra Pearl is a natural pearl gemstone from the Basra region of the Persian Gulf that is held in high regard due to its superior quality. The Basra Moti stone, which represents virtue, is valued for its silky texture and rich hue. Thus, it is known as the "stone of reliability." Natural Basra Pearls, which are entirely natural and not cultured, are not produced in farms but harvested from the depths of the ocean; they have an irregular shape and are extremely rare, consequently they are more expensive. Natural Basra Pearls are more powerful and expensive than South Sea Cultured Pearls.

Natural Basra Pearl offers benefits such as emotional stability, calmness, improved concentration, and increased self-confidence. Basra Pearls are linked to lunar energy, benefiting those seeking emotional balance and harmony. They promote love and understanding between partners. Basra Pearls have a calming effect on the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress and restoring emotional balance.

The most popular use of the elegant Pearl gemstones is in making jewelry, which has been worn by women down the ages and is considered the jewelry of the goddesses. Pearl gemstones have been patronized by the Royalty and the wealthy strata of society since olden times. Pearl stones have an important use in Vedic Astrology for healing certain aspects if reflected in the birth chart of the native.

Natural Basra Pearls have been valued as gemstones for centuries due to their exquisite appearance. Pearl jewelry or the incorporation of pearls into accessories can add a touch of elegance to one's personal style.

Pearls are regarded as symbols of love, chastity, and purity. It is believed that they improve romantic relationships, nurture love, and strengthen emotional bonds. Pearls can be given as gifts to express affection and strengthen relationships.

Basra Moti gemstones are said to possess a nurturing and healing energy that aids in the body's natural healing process. They promote inner peace and balance emotions, consequently, releasing stress and overwhelming states of mind.

Natural Basra Pearls help with decision-making and problem-solving by increasing mental clarity and concentration. They also help with concentration and memory.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Natural Basra Pearl gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Pearl. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Swadhisthana Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness. 

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.   

Pearl is linked to our emotional patterns such as our habits, behavior and personal needs, thus is very recommended for those suffering from instability, fears, insecurity, restlessness, sulkiness, and irrationality can wear a Basra Pearl gem ring. 

You may wear Natural Basra Pearl stones to attract the positive energies of the Moon, especially if your Moon is afflicted in your birth chart. It increases inventiveness, imagination, emotional equilibrium, adaptability, and introspection.

Also, they instill trust and empathy, laying the foundation for long-term relationships. Wearing Basra Pearls as a symbol of love and commitment can be a meaningful and treasured token in relationships.

Important Details:  

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Pearl gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Pearl gemstones.  

Natural Basra Pearl Buying Guide

Check its Origin: 

Basra Pearls are found in the Persian Gulf in the Middle East and natural sea pearls are found in Australia, Japan, Central America, the Gulf of Manaar (between India and Sri Lanka), the coast of Madagascar, Burma (Myanmar), the Philippines, the South Pacific Islands (including Tahiti and Fiji), and South America. Natural river pearls are found in Asia, Europe, and North America. Natural Pearl gemstone breeds are also found in the shorelines of Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, United Arab Emirates, and also in the Indian Ocean.

Natural Basra Pearls, found in the warm, saline waters of the Persian Gulf due to its unique environmental conditions, are regarded as the finest pearls in the world.

Observe their Color:

The most valuable Basra Pearls have a warm, golden overtone, which adds to their overall allure. In the world of pearls, their delicate, shimmering hues attest to their exceptional quality and make them a symbol of purity and elegance.

Notice their Clarity:

The ideal Basra Pearl is clear and flawless with a radiant appearance. High clarity pearls are prized for their pristine beauty and radiance, allowing light to pass through for a captivating sheen. Clarity is important for Basra Pearls. Exceptional clarity is rare and valuable, commanding the highest prices in the market.

Examine their Inclusions:

Natural Basra Pearls are famous for their rarity and beauty, but they also have unique and distinctive inclusions that add to their character. These inclusions may appear as irregularities, blemishes, or even tiny crystalline formations within the nacre layers of the pearl. While some pearls may appear flawless to the naked eye, these inclusions are thought to add to their natural charm and authenticity.

See their Shape:

Natural Basra Pearls are available in a variety of shapes, each with its own distinct charm and appeal. Round, button, oval, and drop-shaped pearls are the most common. Round pearls are the most valuable and classic, with a perfect spherical shape. Oval pearls are longer and more elegant than round pearls, making them ideal for necklaces and earrings.

Check the Carats:

For Basra Pearl of gem quality, the raw Pearl is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, pearls weighing 1 carats and above are appropriate for jewelry. Because Pearl is sold by weight, Pearl prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Pearl has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Basra Pearl

Due to treatments the Pearl stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Pearl do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate 

It is recommended that you should purchase Pearl gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our pearls are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Pearl from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Basra Pearl gemstone to someone else? 

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Pearl gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Pearl is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).  

Color 

The best quality Basra pearls come in light creamy white.

Cut 

The best quality Basra pearls have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, and saturation. Rough Basra pearl gemstones can break due to their fissures.

Carat 

Basra Pearl of 1 carat and above is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger pearls are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Pearl rises as the size/weight/carat increases.   

Clarity 

In the case of Basra pearls, it is difficult or impossible to identify inclusions due to their opaque surface. Gemologists worldwide accept that the Basra pearls do not have any inclusions. If there were any, they would also affect the external appearance or aesthetics. 

Dealers deal in Basra Pearls, which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so you must buy only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputable lab.       

Natural Basra Pearl gemstone Price  

Basra Moti price depends mostly on its color. It increases the value of a pearl if its color is consistent and even. Deep body tones with beautiful overtone colors are more expensive than duller stones. Creamy white Natural Basra pearls are traditional and highly valued. Basra pearl price is also higher as the carat weight increases.

Larger Basra pearls tend to become more valuable and command higher prices due to the fact that they are scarcer and require more time to form within the mollusk. Round pearls, that are symmetrical and spherical in shape, are the most coveted and command the highest prices. The value decreases as the shape becomes more irregular.

It is crucial to acquire untreated, natural pearl gemstones. A gemstone that is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Pearl has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Natural Basra Pearl stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Natural Basra Pearl gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges INR 15,500 to INR 2,73,372 (USD 193 to USD 3.417). 

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Natural Basra Pearl?

The best way to check the authenticity of Basra Pearl is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our pearls are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Pearl carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Pearl is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Pearl have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Pearl, but if you find flaws, then your Pearl is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Pearl are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Pearl. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Pearl, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Pearl from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Pearl. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Pearl. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Natural Basra Pearl Cleaning & Maintenance

Never use an ultrasonic or steam cleaner to clean Natural Basra Pearls. 

It is safe to use soapy, warm water for thorough cleaning on occasion. If the pearls are strung, the string must be completely dry prior to wearing them.

After each use, it is best to wipe the pearls with a very soft, clean cloth for routine maintenance.
